title: School Overview
imageAlt: K.D. Public School Building, Ramlakshan, Deoria
paragraphs: K.D. Public School (U-DISE: 09604113374), situated in Ramlakshan, Deoria (Uttar Pradesh), is committed to delivering quality education and strong moral foundation to students.
Our school provides comprehensive education from Pre-Primary (Nursery, LKG, UKG) to Junior High School / Secondary classes. We focus on academic excellence, discipline, and character building.
With spacious classrooms, dedicated faculty, modern teaching methods, and safe environment, K.D. Public School empowers students to achieve excellence and become responsible citizens.
